objective: Determine whether M1 R-to-R, M2 C-to-R, and M3 R-to-C intervention effects are selective for same-time, history-to-future, or future-to-past latent-video attention edges, while auditing removed contribution dose.
non_goals: Stage 4A does not provide confirmatory population inference with only three cases.
Baseline-relative change is not automatically physical error relative to simulator GT.
Knockout necessity does not by itself identify the complete semantic content of a message.
All720 is not a head-specificity comparison and is used only as a destructive sentinel.

latent_time_modes.future: t_key < t_query; historical K/V to later Query
latent_time_modes.past: t_key > t_query; later K/V to earlier Query reverse-direction control
latent_time_modes.all_time: union of same, future, and past; reused only after strict inventory

token_universe.R: frozen sparse object-token tube tracked on the seed-matched Baseline at 13 latent-video anchors
token_universe.C: all latent-video T*H*W grid tokens outside R
token_universe.runtime_invariant: Q/K/V token count must equal T*H*W

primary_contrasts.cohort: all Stage4 cases with valid target trajectories
primary_contrasts.setting: top100 M1 single-object and all-objects reported separately

primary_contrasts.metric: GT contact-time and post-contact velocity error change
primary_contrasts.fallback_if_gt_ineligible: baseline-relative velocity is diagnostic, not a substitute GT primary

primary_contrasts.cohort: single-object interventions with a trackable other object

secondary_diagnostics: center-aligned object LPIPS after smoke validation
raw attention maps over all query-time anchors

dose.sensitivity_rule: dose-adjusted analysis is allowed only inside common dose support; never use simple effect/dose division as the only correction

stage4_0_hard_gates: same/future/past are disjoint and their removed contribution vectors sum to all-time
all nine directional modes pass exact CPU dose tests
directional dose coverage is finite for every selected head at all 40x2 calls
latent-video token universe runtime invariant passes
one real GPU smoke produces a decodable 49-frame video and complete manifest/dose with joint code provenance
Fast, Trajectory, Survival, center-aligned LPIPS, and shape smoke outputs are readable
inventory finds no conflicting experimental key and marks missing-dose legacy directional videos ineligible for the primary analysis

stage4b.case_count_rule: derive from case-level paired Future-Past variance, user-approved MDE, and corrected primary-family alpha
stage4b.stopping_rule: fixed case count; no adding cases until significance
